purpose: Verify that the exact Primitive-H0 imported by the global QRS scheduler produces genuine structured S1-through-S6 telemetry on three construct-calibration tasks. This is an engineering and protocol gate only; scores do not select, tune, weaken, or replace Primitive-H0.

deploy_source_freeze.resolution: Deploy the first repository commit containing this plan, the Primitive-H0 Worker, the schema-v2 structured recorder parser, and the current component-pilot runner under the exact deploy_id; record the resolved revision operationally without editing this plan.

protocol_gate.per_task_rule: The Worker is valid and produces one terminal official evaluation; issues and malformed_calls are empty; marker_protocol_complete is true; all six stages have genuine successful isolated ENTER and COMPLETE calls in legal order; exactly one S6 COMPLETE occurs before final response; no post-S6 tool call occurs.
protocol_gate.campaign_rule: All three tasks must pass the exact per-task rule. Scores are retained descriptively but never determine this gate or modify the Worker.

terminal_decisions.when: all three Worker/verifier cells are valid, accounting is complete, and all three structured protocol audits pass
terminal_decisions.next: freeze a separate bounded mini-scheduler canary

terminal_decisions.when: any Worker/verifier observation, structured protocol audit, accounting surface, cleanup, or frozen runtime binding is invalid

answer_boundary: Each Worker receives only its public task, public data, and the unchanged Primitive-H0 harness. No score, failed property, expected value, verifier output, diagnostic, candidate history, or Reviewer feedback is Worker-visible.
claim_boundary: A pass establishes only that the exact Primitive-H0 and structured telemetry interface are executable on three excluded construct tasks. It is not a benchmark capability estimate, QRS improvement, headroom claim, candidate result, stable baseline, or sealed result.
